Of the reader's 12 competitor queries, 'sunriver homes for sale' (API: 76 days, 243 impressions, pos 40.5, 53 days in the last 8 weeks) and 'redmond oregon homes for sale' (API: 29 days, 45 impressions, pos 32.0) have never produced a snapshot row because of the cap; 'awbrey butte homes for sale' has no GSC rows at all over 16 months, so its absence is Google not showing the site, not the cap. From the week of 2026-06-01 literal-quoted zero-click queries took 72 of 175 weekly slots (144 of 176 by the week of 2026-08-10) and the plain human head queries dropped out of the series; even head queries that do appear are sampled at 3-10% of their API days ('homes for sale bend oregon' 5 of 229 days). The target_query_benchmark view inherits the cap (4 of 23 registry queries have no dated row) and merges quoted rows into the plain series (its Tetherow position is the quoted query's), and loop-learn-close-windows.ts has no query-level metric mapping, so the loop cannot measure whether a shipped fix moved a target query's position.
corrected_fix: In getSearchConsoleSummary / the GSC ingestor, add one Search Analytics request per target query per day with dimensionFilterGroups on query (operator 'equals' for the plain form; a second filter or a 'contains' + split for the quoted form, since GSC keys the quoted search as a distinct query), dimensions ['query','page'] (date is the per-day call), and upsert rows regardless of rank; when the API returns no row for a target that day, write an explicit zero-impressions row so 'no data' is a recorded observation rather than absence (this is the only measurement 'awbrey butte homes for sale' can have). Store quoted-query rows under a distinct surface prefix (e.g. 'query-quoted:') or a metadata flag and change the target_query_benchmark view to exclude them from the plain series. Add a query-level metric mapping (e.g. gsc_position_28d / gsc_query_impressions_28d over the new rows) to scripts/loop-learn-close-windows.ts so the learn step can close a window on a target query; seed-gsc-ranking-queue.ts's accept text already names that measurement. Backfill via the existing ?startDate/?endDate range (GSC holds 16 months).
